name: Configure managed Markdown roots explicitly
description: Documents the config contract for opting Markdown files into generated-document coverage without forcing every Markdown file to be managed.
decision: Grounded treats the generated docs tree as the default managed Markdown root and exposes managed_markdown_roots in grounded.yml so projects can opt additional Markdown paths into generated-document coverage. The audit only checks Markdown files under the configured roots, which lets teams keep hand-authored Markdown elsewhere while still protecting generated pages where they want coverage.
